target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 2 --text "M1 COMPLETE + VALIDATED. Built entropy_stats (valuation laws, KL in bits, entropy-per-digit, M(s) tilt), critical_events (orbit recorder: b-word, excursions between record-lows, exact criticality), Experiments A (scan-height) and B (tilt-law). RESULTS: (A) height tail log2 Pr(h>=H) has slope ~ -1 (octave 17, 65536 seeds: per-step slopes -0.88..-1.10, mean ~ -1.0) confirming Pr(h>=H)~2^-H. (B) boundary-excluded MIDDLE bulk of high-ascent excursions leans to Cramer tilt p^(1)=3*4^-b: octave 24 rise>=6, len 16-31 band (38402 segs) p1=0.686 vs annealed 0.5 / critical 0.75, KL_to_p1=0.229 < KL_to_annealed=0.403. Full segments dilute via launch/exit boundary layers (why boundary-layer test matters). OPEN: 'C_A-critical' definition is project-internal (H23a/PVT/SRCE, not restated). Literal spec V^2<=2^A P floods event counts (mislabels ordinary excursions once orbit descends to small V). Added --crit-mode {vsq|height}; height (P>=V<<A) is cleaner. Needs user confirmation of the formal C_A certificate; affects B/D and the critical/high_ascent segment labels in C/I." 2>&1 | head -1
echo "=== doctor ==="; ailog doctor 2>&1 | tail -4
